# js-moi-sdk

> js-moi-sdk is a feature-rich JavaScript/TypeScript library for interacting with the MOI Protocol - the participant layer for AI agents. It provides providers, signers, wallets, logic bindings, and utilities. Install: npm install js-moi-sdk. Built by Sarva Labs.

## Documentation

- [js-moi-sdk documentation](https://js-moi-sdk.docs.moi.technology/): js-moi-sdk is a feature-rich JavaScript/TypeScript library for interacting with the MOI Protocol - providers, signers, wallets, logic, and utilities in one SDK.
- [Getting Started](https://js-moi-sdk.docs.moi.technology/getting-started): Install js-moi-sdk with npm and make your first calls to the MOI network - providers, wallet setup, and a first interaction in JavaScript or TypeScript.
- [Constants](https://js-moi-sdk.docs.moi.technology/constants): Protocol constants exposed by js-moi-sdk for the MOI network.
- [Providers](https://js-moi-sdk.docs.moi.technology/providers): Connect to MOI nodes with js-moi-sdk providers - JSON-RPC and WebSocket providers for reading state, balances, tesseracts, and submitting interactions.
- [Signer](https://js-moi-sdk.docs.moi.technology/signer): Sign MOI interactions and messages with js-moi-sdk - the Signer API, wallets, and cryptographic proof of account authority.
- [Interactions](https://js-moi-sdk.docs.moi.technology/interactions): Create, sign, and send MOI interactions with js-moi-sdk - transfers, asset creation, logic deploy and invoke, with complete API reference and examples.
- [Utilities](https://js-moi-sdk.docs.moi.technology/utilities): js-moi-sdk utility functions - encoding, address and identifier helpers, unit conversion, and other tools for MOI development.
- [Agent Skill](https://js-moi-sdk.docs.moi.technology/agent-skill): A downloadable SKILL.md package that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor) the js-moi-sdk API surface, including Voyage devnet flows.
- [Contributions](https://js-moi-sdk.docs.moi.technology/contributions): How to contribute to js-moi-sdk - repository layout, development setup, and pull request guidelines.
- [License and Copyright](https://js-moi-sdk.docs.moi.technology/license-and-copyright): License and copyright terms for js-moi-sdk.

## For AI coding agents

- [Agent Skill](https://js-moi-sdk.docs.moi.technology/agent-skill): download the SKILL.md package that teaches AI coding agents the js-moi-sdk API surface

## MOI ecosystem

- [MOI](https://moi.technology/): the participant layer for AI agents
- [MOI protocol docs](https://docs.moi.technology/): concepts, tutorials, APIs
- [Coco language docs](https://cocolang.dev/): the language for writing MOI logics
